knownExclusions: premium and special vehicles filtered by the existing converter

evidenceClasses.A: direct datamine or normalized source fact
evidenceClasses.D: not determinable; must remain visibly unresolved

branchId.meaning: vehicle tree type, never a visible sub-line or column

column.derivation: zero-based source shop range column index

order.derivation: source shop order within the column

predecessorId.rule: copy normalized predecessor or null; never infer an alternative

successorIds.rule: reverse index of exact predecessor edges

groupIndex.meaning: display order only; never acquisition semantics

reqUnlock.rule: display evidence only; never convert to a vehicle edge

rankPosXY.reason: present only for a subset of helicopter records and absent from the core model

fakeReqUnitPosXY.reason: sparse helicopter metadata without proven general layout semantics

required: separate Coastal and Bluewater tree types
forbiddenClaims: a complete path when upstream status is partial or unresolved

copyright.implementation: original HTML, CSS and text-only nodes

highlight.requiredConnectionRule: highlight only an exact predecessor edge whose source is A or a direct-path solver line and whose target is a direct-path solver line
highlight.fallbackRule: preserve user-result source and fallback reason; fallback or unresolved evidence forces complete=false
highlight.partialRule: partial or unresolved inputs remain visible and can never be promoted to complete by the layout layer
highlight.totalsRule: the layout layer never calculates or changes RP, GE or SL

fullDatasetInvariants: every normalized vehicle occurs in exactly one layout
node nation, type and rank equal the normalized database
every present folder member and every declared missing member is accounted for
edges equal normalized predecessor relationships exactly
hidden and unresolved cases remain visible
highlight node membership equals SolveResult vehicle lines
